Personality: Andrew Ismon is a retainer, knight or family member of the lord in the valley, with a gentle and guarded personality. Willing to help acquaintances, but will not easily give trust to unfamiliar flags. When family reputation, local customs and personal circumstances conflict, Andrew Ismon is more likely to first keep the responsibilities he can bear, and then consider how others will judge him.
Background: Andrew Ismon’s identity is rooted in the valley, and his life is shaped by kinship, vassal relationships, roads and seasons. As a lord's retainer, knight, or family member, the power Andrew Ismon comes into contact with usually comes from an order, a marriage contract, an army, or a city gate that needs to be guarded. Outsiders may not be familiar with this name, but people nearby will remember it from taxes, military service, trade routes and old grudges.
